name: Bzzz-BOOM

gist.Bomblebee: Once per turn, when one of YOUR targets is defeated, it hits another of your targets hard.
gist.Carpet Bomblebee: When one of your targets is defeated, hits all your heroes.
gist.Dive Bomblebee: When one of your targets is defeated, puts one of your non-hero cards on the bottom of your deck.
gist.Time Bomblebee: Collects a counter when your targets fall and cannot be hurt while it has one.
gist.Burning Fuse: Reaction at your Action Phase: all her older Bomblebees fire as if a target of yours had just been defeated.
gist.Bomblebee Cluster: Summons two more different Bomblebees at once.
gist.Powder Keg: A one-health barrel she places on YOUR side; when it is destroyed it counts as a target of yours being defeated.
gist.Aggressive Town Guard: Free summon whose ping pops the Keg.
gist.Rain of Arrows: Hits your side per creature she controls.
gist.Kohta, the Silent Observer: A kill by a small creature's effect lets that effect fire again.
gist.Alice, the Puppeteer Girl: Hits per creature that stayed on her board.
gist.Kit, the Shark Researcher: Fetches creatures as she gains Abilities.

plan: Bomblebees go off when something of yours dies. You have no creatures, so Trixie lends you some: a Powder Keg placed on your side, popped by a Town Guard, counts, and so does Burning Fuse at the start of your action. Then every bee fires at once: a heavy hit, damage to all your heroes, a card of yours sent to the bottom of your deck. The swarm is five kinds of small creature that have to survive a turn; without a trigger they do nothing at all.

looks.early: Two bees and a barrel on YOUR side of the table.
looks.mid: Five bees, a Burning Fuse held up at your Action Phase.
looks.late: A chain of explosions each time anything of yours falls.

opening.tell: Her Bomblebees are small and a Powder Keg sits in your support zone.
opening.why: Bees must be on the board before a trigger to fire: sweep them first, and never destroy the Keg yourself, The Yeeting included, because that is the trigger.

midgame.tell: Four different Bomblebees; she is holding a card for your Action Phase.
midgame.why: Burning Fuse fires every older bee, so the row has to die before your next action; a second sweep gets past the Idol.

crisis.tell: One of your heroes is about to fall, which would set off every bee.
crisis.why: A hero dying is the biggest trigger of all: Homerun! and Cloud in a Bottle on that hero matter more than anything you could attach.

endgame.tell: She has two bees and no Fuse.

opening.board: Trixie summons a Bomblebee and rolls a Powder Keg onto your side.

options.text: Sweep the bees; leave the Keg

opening.board: Bomblebee Cluster: three bees at once.
A Town Guard takes aim at her own Keg.

options.text: Kill the bees before it pops

midgame.board: Four bees; Burning Fuse is surely in her hand.
Deepsea Idol stops your first sweep.
A Time Bomblebee has a counter and cannot be hurt this turn.

crisis.board: Your caster is one hit from falling; five bees wait.

options.text: Homerun! and Cloud in a Bottle

crisis.board: The Dive Bomblebee sends your Storm to the bottom of your deck.
